Why Vajiram & Ravi?

50+ Years of Experience: The Best IAS Coaching in Delhi, India

Vajiram & Ravi maintains its prominence in UPSC preparation through both offline and online formats. Established in 1976, the institute has built a five-decade legacy, adapting to every shift in the examination while staying focused on aspirant outcomes.

The organization features seasoned educators delivering thorough training for the Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages, supported by a consistent track record of student success. Throughout its history, the institute has assisted thousands of candidates in entering the IAS, IPS, IFS, and related government positions through expert mentorship and structured curricula.

  • A proven track record

    AIR 1 in every UPSC result since 2016, and all ten of the top ten ranks in CSE 2025 prepared with us. Founded in 1976 by Prof. P. Velayutham.

  • Expert faculty

    Expert faculty for every GS paper, the optionals and the essay: an academic tradition shaped by educators and subject specialists.

  • Personal guidance

    A plan shaped around your strengths and gaps, with a mentor who keeps it on track from Foundation to Interview.

  • Complete study material

    Notes, test series and interview preparation in one place. 59 questions in Prelims 2025 came from our test series.

  • A prime location

    Over 50 years in Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi, at Gate 5 of Karol Bagh Metro.

  • Learn the way that suits you

    12 UPSC CSE programmes in the classroom and LIVE-Online, with the same teachers and the same tests.

Frequently asked questions

Still unsure? A counsellor can help, with no pressure to enrol.

Talk to a counsellorTalk to a counsellor
Which coaching is best for UPSC?

Vajiram & Ravi is renowned for its comprehensive and structured approach, making it one of the top choices for UPSC coaching in India.

When should I start preparing for UPSC?

Graduates usually join the 1-year GS Prelims cum Mains Programme. College students can start earlier with the 2-year Fledgling programme, which spreads the syllabus across their degree.

What does the GS Prelims cum Mains Programme include?

Daily classes across the full General Studies syllabus, printed study material, Prelims and Mains tests, and mentoring, in the classroom or LIVE-Online.

Can I prepare in Hindi medium?

Yes. Vajiram & Ravi teaches in English and Hindi, with Hindi-medium mentorship and a Mains Test Series in Hindi.

Do you offer coaching for optional subjects?

Yes. Optional coaching runs for 20 to 30 weeks in subjects including Geography, History, Sociology, Psychology, Economics and Political Science, with an Optional Test Series alongside.

How do you prepare students for the UPSC interview?

The Interview Guidance Programme (IGP) prepares you for the Personality Test with mock interviews and DAF preparation, so you face the board with structure and confidence.

Can I join a test series without a full course?

Yes. The Prelims, Mains and Optional test series can be taken on their own, alongside your own preparation.
